title: Representational Acquisition Under Bounded Resources
abstract: arXiv:2603.21736v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A learner's obligation to keep acquired content usable imposes a storage-access tradeoff, with exact endpoints that force different physical organizations. For an exact concept-learning task, we determine the storage-read curve within a constant factor. One-read compound queries force answer-specific cells and exponentially costly updates; one-bit, order-independent updates instead force fact-specific cells. At minimum storage capacity, a robust counterpart holds: when update stretch is averaged uniformly over all semantic cube edges, small excess stretch bounds expected distance from a coordinate encoding under the uniform content distribution. It also bounds the information inaccessible to a one-read consumer. Preservation imposes further constraints. translated_abstract: 学习者必须保持已获取内容可用的义务带来了一种存储-访问权衡，其精确的端点会强制产生不同的物理组织形式。针对一个精确的概念学习任务，我们在常数因子范围内确定了存储-读取曲线。单次读取的复合查询强制要求答案特定的存储单元，并使更新的代价呈指数级增长；而单比特、顺序无关的更新则强制要求事实特定的存储单元。在最小存储容量下，一个鲁棒的对应结论成立：当更新拉伸在所有语义立方体的边上均匀平均时，较小的额外拉伸会在均匀内容分布下限制期望上与坐标编码的距离。它同时限制了单次读取的消费者所无法访问的信息量。保存旧内容会带来进一步的约束。在一个共同的不变就绪状态域上，通过普通零读取覆写所保存的旧内容必须经由未写入的坐标进行分解。分布式编码可能需要
tldr: 本文在常数因子内精确刻画了精确概念学习任务中的存储-读取权衡曲线，证明单次读取的复合查询强制要求答案特定存储单元、单比特顺序无关更新强制要求事实特定存储单元，并给出了最小存储容量下坐标编码的鲁棒性界限以及保存旧内容所需满足的结构性约束。
en_tdlr: This paper determines the storage-read tradeoff curve within a constant factor for exact concept learning, proving that one-read compound queries force answer-specific cells while one-bit order-independent updates force fact-specific cells, and derives robust bounds on coordinate encodings at minimal storage along with structural constraints imposed by content preservation.
